title: Typed Decision Models on Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.19536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typed decision models are language models that answer a question with a fixed set of possible answers by returning a probability for each answer instead of generating text. We study them on tabular data and compare four decision models with three large language models (LLMs) on row classification, fact verification and anomaly detection. Every request is sent in its original form and under 21 types of rewrite that keep its content, such as renaming the options or writing the table in another format. The decision models perform as well as the LLMs at a lower cost. Three of them are also far more robust to how the question is formulated. No model we test is robust to how the table is organized. For every model, at least a third of the row decisions change under some rewrite of the table or the question. translated_title: 表格数据上的类型化决策模型
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型是一类语言模型，它们通过为一组固定的候选答案中的每个答案返回概率来回答问题，而不是生成文本。我们在表格数据上研究这类模型，将四种决策模型与三个大语言模型（LLM）在行分类、事实核查和异常检测任务上进行比较。每个请求都以原始形式发送，同时也在21种保持内容不变的改写下发送，例如重命名选项或以其他格式书写表格。决策模型的表现与LLM相当，但成本更低。其中三个模型对问题的表述方式具有更强的鲁棒性。然而，我们测试的所有模型对表格的组织方式都不鲁棒。对于每个模型，在表格或问题的某种改写下，至少有三分之一的行决策会发生变化。决策模型赋予低概率的决策是最容易发生改变的。决策模型是一种实用的选择。
tldr: 类型化决策模型在表格数据任务上以更低成本达到与大语言模型相当的性能，且对问题表述更加鲁棒，但所有模型对表格组织方式的变化都不够稳健。
en_tdlr: Typed decision models match LLM performance on tabular data tasks at lower cost and show greater robustness to question rephrasing, though no tested model is robust to changes in table organization.
